descriptionHtml: The day 3 session of RoboEDU was started at 6.30 PM on 12th of February by Mr. Adheesha Liyanage as the speaker. After the introduction of the topic for the day, useful theoretical knowledge in identifying the concepts was delivered to the participants. In addition, the significance of control statements in programming was also explained during the session with the coding and online simulations which were beneficial to comprehending the uses and applications of control statements to solve a problem and increase the efficiency of the code to meet with the particular requirements of an Arduino project. Moreover, basic knowledge of analog and digital signals was also given in order to identify and read inputs using Arduino in various applications. From this session, the participants were able to get a clear understanding of the usefulness of control statements in Arduino programming with online simulations. Finally, the Q & A session was held and the event ended marking another successful and remarkable day of the RoboEDU workshop series.
